args.title: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 — Summary (Main + Companion)
args.body:
• Carriers sharing live sensor data cut temperature excursions by 30% in 2026.
• Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from reduced spoilage.
• Companion piece: pilot programs using this approach cut claims by a quarter (25%).

Sources:
- https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/cold-chain
- https://insights.bellwether.example/cold-chain/companion (subscriber content, accessed via team code)
